{"id":"mimid-5km1","title":"open_direct hosts a doomed second room after accept_invite, before the sync","description":"Found while fixing bead mimid-604m.8, which closed the window a
Store::sync could join a one-to-one room in: one more way to reach the
same end, with no race at all.

Store::accept_invite (crates/mimid-agent-store/src/action.rs) joins the
room and leaves the record to the next sync ("The room's record and
messages come with the next Store::sync"). Between that call and that
sync the agent is in the room and nothing in the records says so, so
Store::open_direct with the other user finds nothing three ways over:

1. Store::direct_room reads the records, which have no room;
2. Store::reveal_direct looks only at hidden rooms (State::hidden_rooms),
   and a room that was never recorded has no hiddenRoom tombstone;
3. Store::host hosts a second fixed-membership room for the pair, the
   hub refuses its first Commit under room-policy-04 section 5 ("Only a
   single fixed-membership room can exist for any unique set of
   participants"), host leaves the half-made room and the user's message
   fails with their room already there.

Reachable with an invite policy other than Any -- the policy decides
whether a Welcome is joined by the sync or waits for the user -- when the
user accepts an invite to a one-to-one room and opens a DM with that
person before the sync that records it. accept_invite calls want_sync, so
the window is a sync away rather than permanent.

The fix is not another lock: the lock is already held across the three
looks. It is that reveal_direct asks the wrong question. Asking the agent
for a direct room with this user that has no active record, rather than
for a hidden one, covers both this and the hidden case it covers now.
What needs deciding is the room the user deleted here (State::is_forgotten
makes Store::room_for return None for it): adopting it would undo a
delete, and hosting a second one cannot work either, so that case wants
an error of its own rather than either.

new_value:
Store::reveal_direct asks the agent for an active direct room with the user that has no record here, instead of looking through the hiddenRoom tombstones, so Store::open_direct finds a room Store::accept_invite joined and left to the next sync as well as a hidden one; commit bac77a81 on worktree-agent-a664850321e9e3361. The records are read once before the loop (room_for takes their lock again), inside the agent lock open_direct already holds from its first look to the hosting. A room with a record is left out whatever its status: a leaving or left record of a room the agent is active in is Store::sync's reconcile_rooms to make active again. Regression test: mimid-agent-store tests/groundwork.rs open_direct_finds_an_accepted_room_the_records_do_not_have (fails without the fix: Refused "a fixed-membership room with these participants exists already").

The deleted-room case is left to Mark, unchanged, as bead mimid-6vsk: a room the user deleted (Tombstone::Room, State::forgotten_rooms) is left out of the look, so open_direct still hosts a second room, the hub still refuses it, and the user's message still fails until the next sync. Adopting it would undo the delete; an error of its own is the finder's reading; and Store::sync's settle_forgotten_rooms clears the tombstone of a room the agent is active in, so the next sync makes a record for it again either way. mimid-6vsk has the facts and the three readings.
